description: Check an e-mail address without sending mail: whether its domain exists and takes mail, and whether a disposable domain list names it. It cannot tell whether the mailbox exists.
name: email_address_check

accepts_mail.description: true when mail_route is mx or implicit_mx.

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

disposable.description: true when the disposable domain list names the domain or a parent of it. null while the list is not loaded.

disposable_listed_domain.description: The name the list holds: the domain or a parent of it. null unless disposable is true.

domain_exists.description: false when the resolver said the domain does not exist.

email.description: It is the address, with its domain in lower case.

mail_route.description: It is mx when MX hosts take the mail, implicit_mx when the domain has no MX and its own address takes it, null_mx when it takes no mail, or none when it has no MX, A or AAAA record. null when the domain does not exist.

mx_hosts.description: The MX records, as dns_lookup writes them.

unavailable.description: It holds disposable_listed_domain with not_synced while the disposable domain list is not loaded. It is {} otherwise.

title: Email Address Check
